summary: LittleLink is a self-hosted alternative to proprietary link-in-bio services. It provides a static page featuring a collection of branded buttons that direct visitors to your various online profiles and websites.
goodFor: Individuals who want a simple, customisable landing page for their social media profiles without relying on third-party SaaS providers.
watchOut: It offers basic functionality and lacks the advanced analytics, automated integrations, or user management systems found in commercial equivalents.
deployNotes: As a JavaScript-based static site, it typically requires only a basic web server or container to serve the assets and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
